input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 gives a professional/workmanlike warranty, 90-day Deliverable conformance (hosted Services for the whole term), no-malicious-code and compliance-with-law warranties, and re-perform/repair/replace with refund and termination as remedies. The disclaimer in 19.5 expressly does not limit the express warranties, so the express warranty is not swallowed.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets our preferred limits exactly (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' compensation), runs for the term plus one year, requires certificates on request, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liability.

input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: This is a three-year, USD 6,000,000 take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right — the playbook walk-away case, and inconsistent with Section 12.3's statement that we have made no minimum-volume commitment. We have narrowed it to the fallback: current 12-month term only, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up instead of a take-or-pay penalty.

input.quote: On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period.
input.rationale: Section 10 assumes an "agreed transition period" but imposes no transition-assistance obligation and no Customer Data return, export-format or deletion-certification obligation anywhere (Section 16.5 covers only Confidential Information and cross-refers to a non-existent Section 11). For a hosted-services agreement that is a deviation, so we have inserted six months' assistance, 30-day machine-readable data return and certified deletion.
